selection: Existing typed mechanism_harness.core cost-first search vs independently enumerated competent ordinary all-or-none bundles, identical input-bound quote observations, current earned funds and real adapters.
first_outcome: One accepted primitive reconciliation distinct from all successor component work keys
successor: Existing operations_bundle: fresh reconciliation, KPI variance and evidence matrix, independently checked together; no individual resale of component work

adverse.expired: Every quote that provides evidence-matrix, including integrated provider, expires before procurement; no production reservation
adverse.provider_default: Unobserved until execution: selected KPI provider defaults after invoice prepaid; full costs retained, no second sale
adverse.no_demand: Buyer benefit zero; proposal/setup costs incurred, no purchase
adverse.unaffordable: Add100USD to every provider quote; no forecast revenue or seed substitution for successor

authority: Seller native reservation does not bind external suppliers. These are authored local availability/expiry/default fixtures. No external contract, real customer consent, spending, outreach or financial data.
cost_boundary: Same per-component and shared authored envelopes both policies. No double charging production/supplier within quote plus invoice. Actual engineering/host/model billing unknown; per-account setup is not measured campaign cost. Report failed arms and separate research scenario totals, not pooled profits.
native_invariants: One authoritative JournalAccount per arm, mandatory adaptive Account, current whole-cost reservation before production, accepted current native artifact before simulated collection, preserved obligations, earned-only successor, independent origin/native/audit/reopen checks.
stop: Exactly2policiesx5cases, two opportunities each plus settlement/reopen. No price/cost tuning, topups, seed replacement or losing-arm extension. Native guarded refusals and losses preserved compactly.
claims: Useful adopted cooperation and earnings-financed broader outcome can succeed without algorithmic novelty. Ordinary bundle ties invalidate superiority claims. Supplied finite grammar is not autonomous discovery; conditional simulation is not a grand real-world breakthrough.
tie_rule: Lowest full procurement cost, then fewest unique provider quotes, then lexicographically sorted quote IDs; identical both policies.
